article_notes: Prospective observational study, Onderstepoort (OVAH), Dec 2015 – Jan 2017: 35 dogs with B. rossi (confirmed by PCR/RLB; B. vogeli and E. canis excluded) and 10 healthy controls. Severity: complicated (n=25; at least one complication at presentation or during hospitalisation: collapse, hypotension MAP < 80 mmHg, severe anaemia HCT < 0.15, haemoconcentration, secondary IMHA, AKI by IRIS grading, hypoglycaemia < 3.3 mmol/L, jaundice bilirubin > 50 µmol/L, cerebral babesiosis, ARDS) vs uncomplicated (n=10). Extracted: all 12 Table 4 markers (Mann-Whitney U, T0) and the per-group proportion of increased sSDMA. Not extracted: infected vs healthy comparisons at T0 (Table 2: sCr, urea, USG, uOsmol, UPC; Table 3: uIgG, uCRP, uRBP, uNGAL, pNGAL, u/pNGAL, sSDMA = 12 tested markers; Table 1 haematology/biochemistry is descriptive only; uncomplicated vs healthy sCr P=0.009), and the T0/T24h/T1m follow-up changes (not compared between outcome groups). Mortality (4/35 died or euthanised) and AKI (8 dogs) were not used as groups for any marker comparison. Two post-mortem renal histology case descriptions are descriptive only. PDF conversion inserted line numbers into the text; Table 4 is clean. The first author's group also reported B. rossi kidney injury in Defauw et al. 2012 (a different, earlier cohort, cited in the Discussion).

severity_definitions.label: complicated vs uncomplicated babesiosis
severity_definitions.definition: Complicated when at least one complication was diagnosed at presentation or during hospitalisation: collapse (unable to walk unaided), hypotension (MAP < 80 mmHg), severe anaemia (HCT < 0.15), haemoconcentration (HCT > 0.37 with intravascular haemolysis), secondary IMHA (positive in-saline agglutination), AKI (IRIS grading, incl. grade I = sCr rise >= 26.4 µmol/L within 48 h), hypoglycaemia (< 3.3 mmol/L), jaundice (total bilirubin > 50 µmol/L), cerebral babesiosis, ARDS. Based on Jacobson and Clark 1994, Jacobson 2006, WHO 2014.
severity_definitions.quote: Ten dogs were diagnosed with uncomplicated babesiosis, while at least one complication occurred in each of the remaining 25 dogs.
